query:
SELECT h.edge_id,p.node_id,cr.node_id,json_extract(p.properties_json,'$.crPackId'),json_extract(cr.properties_json,'$.tdocNumber'),json_extract(cr.properties_json,'$.summaryOfChange')
FROM edge h JOIN _node_record p ON p.node_id=h.src_id JOIN _node_record cr ON cr.node_id=h.dst_id
WHERE h.rel_type='HAS_CR' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(p.labels_json) WHERE value='CRPack') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(cr.labels_json) WHERE value='CR') ORDER BY h.edge_id
